problem_domain: UNNC student BBS forum + private messaging platform as WeChat mini-program, replacing alink. Must be open-source, non-profit, WeChat-login-only, with category-based threaded discussion and real-time direct messaging.

references.name: july_client / july_server (WeChat native BBS + chat)
references.relevance: Closest architectural match: WeChat native mini-program BBS with WebSocket real-time chat, Lin UI components, category-based posting, and subscription message templates. Demonstrates the WeChat-native + WebSocket pattern in production.
references.architecture_pattern: Client-server with WebSocket push channel. WeChat native frontend (Lin UI), Node.js backend with WebSocket for real-time messaging.
references.interface_style: REST API for CRUD operations (posts, comments, users), WebSocket for real-time messaging channel. JSON payloads throughout.
references.extension_strategy: WeChat mini-program subpackage loading for modules >2MB. Backend routes organized by domain module.
references.error_handling: WeChat native error callbacks (fail/complete) on frontend. Backend returns structured error JSON with codes.

key_tradeoffs.reason: Better WeChat ecosystem integration, Skyline render engine, smaller bundle size
Resource efficiency in mini-program sandbox, multiplexed message routing
REST simpler for CRUD, cacheable, easier to debug

references.name: FastAPI Forum Backend (2025 best practices)
references.relevance: Direct technical reference for building a BBS backend in Python FastAPI with async SQLAlchemy, JWT auth, Pydantic v2 validation. Matches the project's Python constraint from .claude/ tooling.
references.architecture_pattern: Layered: Routes → Services → Repositories → Models. Strict inward-pointing dependencies. Application factory pattern with lifespan management.
references.interface_style: RESTful JSON API with FastAPI auto-generated OpenAPI docs. JWT Bearer auth. Async PostgreSQL via SQLAlchemy 2.0 + asyncpg.
references.extension_strategy: Modular route registration. Pydantic v2 for request/response schemas enables versioning. Alembic for schema migrations.
references.error_handling: Custom exception hierarchy → FastAPI exception handlers → structured JSON error responses. Validation errors caught at Pydantic layer before reaching business logic.

key_tradeoffs.reason: Full async stack avoids thread overhead, matches FastAPI async model
Simpler to deploy, no Redis dependency needed for MVP, WeChat code exchange provides initial trust
Stable under concurrent inserts, better performance for infinite scroll patterns
Simpler model, sufficient for typical forum thread depths. Closure table added if nested threading needed.

references.name: WeChat Mini-Program WebSocket IM Architecture
references.relevance: Official WeChat documentation on WebSocket constraints, SocketTask API, and lifecycle management for real-time messaging in mini-programs.
references.architecture_pattern: Client-side: SocketTask with state machine (idle→connecting→connected→reconnecting→failed). Server-side: WebSocket endpoint + session manager + message router + offline queue.
references.interface_style: WSS protocol (mandatory for production). JSON message frames with type/from/to/content/timestamp/msgId fields. Heartbeat PING/PONG every 30s.
references.extension_strategy: Message types extensible via JSON 'type' discriminator field. STOMP sub-protocol optional for pub/sub routing.
references.error_handling: Exponential backoff reconnection (1s→2s→4s→8s, max 5 retries). Offline message queue on server with delivery confirmation on reconnect. ACK protocol for guaranteed delivery.

key_tradeoffs.reason: WeChat resource constraints, simpler state management
Mobile network reliability requires delivery confirmation
WeChat onHide/onShow events are reliable signals; aggressive keepalive drains battery

references.name: linfeng-community (SpringBoot full-stack social forum)
references.relevance: Feature-complete reference for BBS domain modeling: posts, comments, categories, private messages, user roles, moderation. Provides the feature taxonomy to match or simplify.
references.architecture_pattern: SpringBoot monolith with module separation. REST API + WebSocket IM. Redis for caching and message queue. Frontend via Uni-app (multi-platform).
references.interface_style: RESTful with JWT. WebSocket for IM. Redis pub/sub for async task decoupling.
references.extension_strategy: Role-based access control (admin/moderator/user). Plugin-like module structure for extensibility.
references.error_handling: Global exception handler with structured error codes. Transaction rollback on service-layer failures.

key_tradeoffs.reason: Small user base (UNNC students only), monolith simpler to deploy and maintain, split later if needed
Already needed for caching; dual-use avoids extra infrastructure for MVP

conclusion: Consensus: REST + WebSocket hybrid with JWT auth. Python FastAPI chosen over Node.js/PHP alternatives because: (1) matches existing .claude/ Python tooling, (2) FastAPI's async model handles WebSocket + HTTP on same server, (3) Pydantic v2 provides request validation equivalent to TypeScript-level safety. WeChat native (not Uni-app) for frontend — already scaffolded, Skyline render engine, best platform integration. PostgreSQL for relational data (users, posts, comments, messages). Single WebSocket connection for real-time messaging with heartbeat + exponential backoff reconnection. Layered backend (Routes → Services → Repositories) with async SQLAlchemy. Monolith deployment — UNNC student scale (~10k users) doesn't justify microservices overhead.
